title: Text Editor with Undo/Redo (Command)
summary: Insert and delete as command objects with undo, redo, a bounded history and correct redo invalidation.
hints: `InsertCommand` remembers `(pos, text)`. Its undo deletes `[pos, pos+len)`. `DeleteCommand` must **capture the removed text** in `execute()` so undo can put it back.
Use two deques. `run`: execute, push to undo, clear redo. `undo`: pop undo, call undo, push redo. `redo`: pop redo, execute, push undo.
Validate **before** creating or recording a command. Invalid operations and no-ops never enter the history.
Bounded history: when the undo stack exceeds `maxHistory`, drop the **oldest** entry (`removeLast` on an `ArrayDeque` used as a stack).
